```python
def reduce(instance):
    m = instance["num_vars"]
    clauses = instance["clauses"]
    
    # vertex indices
    T, F, B = 0, 1, 2
    edges = [[T, F], [F, B], [B, T]]
    
    pos = {}
    neg = {}
    n = 3
    for v in range(1, m+1):
        pos[v] = n
        neg[v] = n+1
        n += 2
        edges.append([pos[v], neg[v]])
        edges.append([pos[v], B])
        edges.append([neg[v], B])
    
    def lit_vertex(lit):
        v = abs(lit)
        return pos[v] if lit > 0 else neg[v]
    
    for clause in clauses:
        l1, l2, l3 = clause
        x = n
        y = n+1
        n += 2
        a = lit_vertex(l1)
        b = lit_vertex(l2)
        c = lit_vertex(l3)
        edges.append([x, a])
        edges.append([x, b])
        edges.append([x, T])
        edges.append([y, x])
        edges.append([y, c])
        edges.append([y, T])
    
    return {"n": n, "edges": edges}
```

```python
def reduce(instance):
    m = instance["num_vars"]
    clauses = instance["clauses"]
    
    # vertex indices
    T, F, B = 0, 1, 2
    edges = [[T, F], [F, B], [B, T]]
    
    pos = {}
    neg = {}
    n = 3
    for v in range(1, m+1):
        pos[v] = n
        neg[v] = n+1
        n += 2
        edges.append([pos[v], neg[v]])
        edges.append([pos[v], B])
        edges.append([neg[v], B])
    
    def lit_vertex(lit):
        v = abs(lit)
        return pos[v] if lit > 0 else neg[v]
    
    for clause in clauses:
        l1, l2, l3 = clause
        x = n
        y = n+1
        n += 2
        a = lit_vertex(l1)
        b = lit_vertex(l2)
        c = lit_vertex(l3)
        edges.append([x, a])
        edges.append([x, b])
        edges.append([x, T])
        edges.append([y, x])
        edges.append([y, c])
        edges.append([y, T])
    
    return {"n": n, "edges": edges}
```
